Are you an experienced Supply Chain Planner who enjoys working in a dynamic, high-tech manufacturing environment? Do you know how to translate complex data into reliable forecasts while maintaining close collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders? Then this could be the next step in your career. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the global demand plan. You play a key role in balancing customer demand with production capacity, enabling the organization to achieve excellent delivery performance while optimizing inventory levels and supply chain efficiency. Working closely with teams across the business, you combine analytical insights with a hands-on mindset to ensure a reliable and agile planning process. Your responsibilities As Senior Supply Chain Planner, you will: Develop, maintain and continuously improve the global demand planning process. Analyze historical sales data, customer forecasts and market developments to create accurate demand plans. Collaborate closely with Production, Procurement, Logistics, Project Management and Account Management to align planning activities. Build strong relationships with customers and proactively manage fluctuations in demand. Monitor supply chain risks, identify potential bottlenecks and implement timely corrective actions. Drive process improvements by applying Lean and continuous improvement principles. Challenge existing ways of working and contribute to a more efficient and data-driven planning organization. Support business decisions by providing clear planning insights and performance analyses. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Joining us means becoming part of an innovative organization where your expertise has a direct impact on operational performance. You can expect: A long-term position with the prospect of permanent employment. A gross monthly salary between €4,000 and €6,000, depending on your knowledge and experience. 27 vacation days plus paid public holidays. 8.33% holiday

allowance. Travel expense reimbursement. Comprehensive relocation support, including assistance with temporary housing, relocation bonus and practical support with registration, banking, insurance and onboarding. Visa and work permit support where applicable. Personal guidance throughout your employment and access to an extensive professional network within the Dutch high-tech industry. Functie-eisen You are a confident and analytical professional who enjoys taking ownership and making well-founded decisions. You communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels and are comfortable working in a fast-paced production environment. In addition, you bring: A Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related discipline. At least 7 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning or Forecasting within a manufacturing environment. Advanced analytical skills and extensive experience with Excel and Business Intelligence tools. Experience with Lean, Kaizen or other Continuous Improvement methodologies. Strong stakeholder management skills and experience working directly with customers. The ability to translate data into practical business decisions. Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Their team of engineers, designers, and visionaries is dedicated to crafting technologies that solve real-world challenges and unlock new possibilities. Their mission encompasses a holistic approach to innovation. They aim to address not just immediate needs but also the broader goals of social, environmental, and economic sustainability. By creating meaningful technologies, they contribute to building a future where everyone can thrive, where resources are optimized and where connectivity brings people together. Are you an experienced Quality Manager ready to lead change in a high-tech manufacturing environment? Xelvin is looking for a Quality Manager to join an internationally operating technology company in the Eindhoven region. In this strategic leadership role, you will drive quality excellence, lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers, and play a key role in supporting the company's growth ambitions within the semiconductor industry. If you thrive in complex technical environments, enjoy leading people through transformation, and are passionate about continuous improvement, this could be your next career move. About the role Our client is a leading supplier of highly engineered precision components used in advanced technological applications. Operating within the global semiconductor supply chain, the company develops and manufactures critical products that contribute to some of the world's most innovative technologies. As Quality Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of approximately ten quality professionals, ranging from experienced specialists to ambitious junior engineers. You will ensure product and process quality standards are maintained while driving organizational improvements, fostering collaboration, and strengthening a culture of operational excellence. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A challenging leadership role within a rapidly growing high-tech organization. Competitive salary based on experience and expertise. Performance-based bonus scheme. 27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days. Excellent pension and secondary benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth, training, and career development. An international work environment with colleagues from over 25 nationalities. A culture focused on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Regular company events, sports activities, and social gatherings. Functie-eisen To succeed in this position, you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another relevant

technical discipline. Proven leadership experience within quality management in a high-tech manufacturing environment. Experience within the semiconductor industry or a similarly demanding technical sector. Strong knowledge of quality methodologies and continuous improvement tools such as Six Sigma, DMAIC, PDCA, SPC, 8D, APQP, and PPAP. Experience with quality management systems and QESH standards. Demonstrated experience in change management and organizational development. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Hier kom je te werken Our client is an internationally recognized technology manufacturer specializing in high-precision engineered components for demanding industrial applications. Their products play a critical role in advanced manufacturing environments where reliability, accuracy, and consistency are essential. Driven by innovation and continuous improvement, the company serves leading customers worldwide and operates within one of the fastest-growing sectors of the global technology market. Employees benefit from a collaborative, multicultural environment where technical expertise, personal development, and teamwork are highly valued.
